exact_statement: Let N_odd(f) be the number of 2-faces of {0,1}^n on which f has corner product -1 and Q(f)=2^(1-n) N_odd(f). exact_statement: In A021 v1 section 2, R(q) := -2(1-q)^2 log2(1-q) - (2cq - 3cq^2) with c = log2 e equals +4c sum_{j>=3} q^j/[j(j-1)(j-2)] and satisfies 0 <= R(q) <= 2cq^3/[3(1-q)]; consequently G_s = R(u) - R(2u)/2 <= 0. A021 states the opposite signs (R <= 0, G_s >= 0).
